sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Engines (Level 2). Diesel: compression ignition, glow plugs, and why bad fuel kills injectors.
📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 2 skills from your past — check your Journal.
This is home ground. You grew up on country like this.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Ethan Abramowitz. Truck driver. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dispatcher's headset, Trail compass, Tasting Spoon, Dog tags, Photo album. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night,
A person, maybe 40s, with a limp: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."

Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
